name: revised-down
about: §4R L2: Meta revised yesterday's numbers down overnight; the fold holds only the revised figures, which are smaller than the first report.

output.headline: On 2026-11-02, 1 campaign ran and delivered 2 leads at $55.45 each from $110.90 in spend.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, pulling 70 clicks from 6,015 impressions at a 1.2% click rate.
The 2 leads it produced came at $55.45 cost per lead, which accounts for all of the day's $110.90 spend.
Month-to-date spend on Meta for 2026-11 sits at $198.00, with 29 days still remaining in the month.

The mature cohort from the week of 2026-09-28 continues to show solid funnel movement: 40 leads, with 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 qualified (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost (22.5%).
The mature cohort from the week of 2026-09-21 had 38 leads, with 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 qualified (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost (21.1%).
The cohort from the week of 2026-10-26 has 12 leads with 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, 1 lost, and 0 hired so far — it is too young to judge rates.
